title: Layer manifest
description: What one layer of the framework repository holds, at <layer>/layer.json and packages/naive/src/engine/layer.json for the system layer (EE-018, EE-071). A layer organizes the framework repo. It is not a venture package. Venture packages live at library/packages/<name>/package.json. A kit is Mentura's word, at platform/kits/. packages/naive/src/checks/check-data-model.mjs checks this file.

purpose.description: What the layer is for, in one sentence

product.description: The product card that offers this layer's work, as <venture id>/<product id>

path.description: The SKILL.md, from the repo root

tier.description: Optional: the MAD tier a skill serves, for a venture that uses MAD (a separate product since EE-038)

standalone.description: Useful without the rest of the layer

move_to.description: A proposed owning layer or package, when the skill is filed in the wrong place

records.description: Record types this layer owns (data-model ids). Venture records that a package owns are listed on the package, not here.

reads.description: Record types owned elsewhere that this layer's skills and checks read

writes.description: Record types owned elsewhere that this layer's skills write

checks.description: Scripts that check or run this layer's records, from the repo root
